# Ernest Windel Dreo

> Personal portfolio of Ernest Windel Dreo, a software engineer in the Philippines working on full-stack development, AI, and web design.

## Portfolio

- [Overview](https://ernestwindeldreo.vercel.app/): Introduction, selected work, toolkit, and social profiles.
- [Projects](https://ernestwindeldreo.vercel.app/projects): Software, AI, and Web3 projects.
- [Experience](https://ernestwindeldreo.vercel.app/experience): Professional experience.
- [Stack](https://ernestwindeldreo.vercel.app/stack): Languages, frameworks, and tools.
- [Certifications](https://ernestwindeldreo.vercel.app/certifications): Courses and certificates.
- [Contact](https://ernestwindeldreo.vercel.app/contact): Public contact information and email draft form.
- [Playground](https://ernestwindeldreo.vercel.app/playground): Interactive browser games.

## Interactive features

- [Typing test](https://ernestwindeldreo.vercel.app/typing-test): English and Filipino typing practice.
- [Erza](https://ernestwindeldreo.vercel.app/ask): Portfolio assistant. Responses are generated and should be checked against the portfolio's published information.
